d: Responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the fuel station, ensuring prompt, efficient, and courteous service to customers. This includes directing the work of assigned Forecourt Attendants, refueling vehicles, servicing with oil, water, and air, selling dry items, and performing other forecourt duties. The role also involves managing fuel replenishment in storage tanks, preparing inventory sheets, recording timesheets, and ensuring adequate storage availability. Additionally, the position is accountable for handling cash inventory, managing opening and closing cash procedures, and running the station effectively during assigned shifts in compliance with company standards.

Bapco Energies operates a portfolio spanning the entire energy value chain in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The portfolio includes wholly-owned subsidiaries and specialized operating companies. Together, these companies drive Bapco Energies' mission to power the next generation.
